run_restitution_demo: run the pybullet restitution demo that simulates a bouncing sphere with adjustable friction and restitution sliders
create_debug_parameter: create a pybullet user debug parameter slider to control restitution or friction values at runtime
load_urdf_model: load a URDF model such as a plane or sphere into the pybullet physics simulation
change_dynamics_restitution: change the restitution and friction dynamics of a pybullet body using changeDynamics
set_physics_engine_parameter: set the physics engine restitution velocity threshold parameter in pybullet
